scope: live disposable network namespaces on Linux

profiles.name: demand_idle
profiles.ground_truth: zero offered traffic; local capacity is unused

profiles.name: demand_background
profiles.special_condition: one background class exceeds the local root rate
profiles.ground_truth: application demand exceeds configured local capacity

profiles.name: demand_bursty
profiles.special_condition: critical 100000-byte releases every 500 ms; background releases every 100 ms
profiles.ground_truth: per-window demand is bursty; scheduled mean is below root rate; queue state is measured independently

profiles.name: demand_receiver
profiles.special_condition: peer receive buffer is constrained to 4096 bytes and reader is throttled
profiles.ground_truth: receiver window is deliberately constrained; classification remains suspected

profiles.name: demand_pacing
profiles.ground_truth: socket pacing is below offered demand and verified local root capacity

profiles.name: demand_class
profiles.special_condition: background HTB class rate and ceil are reduced to 1 Mbit/s
profiles.ground_truth: class allocation is below offered demand while root capacity is available

profiles.name: demand_remote
profiles.special_condition: rate and delay are imposed on the router-side namespace interface
profiles.ground_truth: controlled bottleneck is outside the monitored sender namespace

profiles.name: demand_capacity_drop
profiles.special_condition: HTB root and child capacities are reduced after six load windows
profiles.ground_truth: offered traffic remains above local capacity before and after reduction

profiles.name: demand_recovery
profiles.special_condition: HTB capacity rises after six load windows
profiles.ground_truth: offered demand exceeds capacity before recovery and fits afterward

profiles.name: demand_mixed_udp
profiles.special_condition: UDP sends 1200-byte messages every 1.2 ms; every tenth message is urgent
profiles.ground_truth: aggregate offered load exceeds root capacity and UDP message outcomes are application-counted

profiles.name: demand_load
profiles.special_condition: two independent TCP flows run for 3.5 seconds
profiles.ground_truth: aggregate scheduled demand is 16 Mbit/s against a 4 Mbit/s root

accounting.bytes_offered: payload bytes released by the synthetic application generator
accounting.bytes_admitted: payload bytes accepted by the synthetic application for this window; the lab has no separate application admission controller
accounting.bytes_transmitted: payload bytes accepted by socket send/sendto calls; not wire delivery
accounting.bytes_received: payload bytes read by the peer application in the same sampling window
accounting.udp_send_failures: datagrams not fully accepted by sendto

evaluation.accuracy_source: scenario-controlled topology, verified qdisc readback, and known generator schedule
evaluation.burst_profile_accuracy: not reduced to one label; inspect per-window offered demand and independent queue measurements
evaluation.recovery_profile_accuracy: compare pre-change and post-change epochs separately
